statement_en: Xia Yanjing treats the Xia dynasty as the beginning of Chinese civilization and the transition from primitive to slave society, citing Erlitou and Yanshi Shang City as evidence that by the late Xia there were palaces, workshops and ritual bronzes and jades—the conditions of a state political center.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖把夏朝定为中国文明史的开端，认为它意味着由原始社会进入奴隶社会；二里头遗址及偃师商城等考古材料证明，夏代晚期已具备宫殿、手工作坊和礼仪青铜器、玉器等国家政治中心条件。

discussion_notes: 知识链接以“封建王朝政治”解释青铜时代高峰，并引《左传》鼎迁记载。

source_span.chapter: 夏商周时期的艺术设计
source_span.section: 1. 青铜鼎器与礼制性设计 / 知识链接：青铜器与封建王朝的统治

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that in the Shang and Zhou bronzes served chiefly as symbols of ruling power, with changes of power expressed through them—as in the Zuozhuan records that “Jie had muddled virtue, and the cauldrons moved to Shang” and “Zhou Xin was cruel, and the cauldrons moved to Zhou.”
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为商周时期青铜器主要是统治权力的象征，权力的更替也通过青铜器来体现；《左传》所记“桀有昏德，鼎迁于商”“商纣暴虐，迁鼎于周”即是其表现。

discussion_notes: 原文在论述“礼治”四点后作出该总结性判断。

source_span.chapter: 夏商周时期的艺术设计
source_span.section: 1. 青铜鼎器与礼制性设计 / 青铜器的礼制意义

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that the ritual design of bronzes embodied a strong idea and cultural conception of “ritual stored in vessels,” which shaped the forms and styles of Xia-Shang-Zhou bronzes and remained an important theme in design culture through later dynasties.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，青铜器的礼制设计含有浓厚的“藏礼于器”思想与文化观念，不仅造就了夏商周三代青铜器的形制风格与特色，也成为历朝历代设计文化中的重要命题。

discussion_notes: 原文在“礼制器具设计”节引《周礼》与《左传》，并以“藏礼于器”概括。

source_span.section: 1. 青铜鼎器与礼制性设计 / 3）礼制器具设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing shows that Western Zhou rulers established a ritual system strictly limiting the number and specifications of vessels used in sacrifices and ceremonies, so that noble and base, high and low were distinguished—the principle of “ritual stored in vessels”—as in the Zhouli quotas of nine ding for the Son of Heaven, seven for lords, five for ministers and three for officers.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖指出，西周奴隶主为加强统治规定了一整套礼制，对祭祀和典礼所用礼器的数量与规格作严格限制，使贵贱有等、上下有别，即“藏礼于器”；《周礼》所载天子九鼎、诸侯七鼎、大夫五鼎、士三鼎是其制度表现。

discussion_notes: 原文以春秋中期莲鹤方壶为例，说明礼制松弛后青铜器风格与实用器型的变化。

source_span.section: 1. 青铜鼎器与礼制性设计 / 3）礼制器具设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing treats the Spring and Autumn period as a phase in which ritual constraints loosened and bronze style changed: daily bronzes began to lose their sacrificial and ritual character, design shed the mythological atmosphere inherited from Shang and Zhou, and a livelier style emerged, exemplified by the Lotus and Crane Square Hu.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖把春秋时期视为礼制松弛、青铜器风格转变的阶段：日用青铜器开始失去祭祀与礼器特性，造型设计摆脱商周以来的神话气氛，向较活泼的风格发展，莲鹤方壶是这种风格的典型代表。

discussion_notes: 原文以司母戊鼎、四羊尊、龙虎尊、食人卣、人面纹铜钺及五爵中的觚、角、方彝为例展开对比。

source_span.section: 1. 青铜鼎器与礼制性设计 / 4）设计风格

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that Shang bronzes display an unusually strong aesthetic pursuit beyond practical function but lack a unified standard: some vessels are grave and massive, others exaggerated to the grotesque and mysterious, and some accommodate practical use while others do not.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为殷商时期青铜器超出实用功能之上的审美追求表现得异常强烈，但缺乏统一标准：一部分器物凝重浑厚，一部分被夸张到怪诞神秘，还有一部分考虑实用功能、另一部分则不予考虑。

discussion_notes: 原文在“陶器”节以夏代陶瓮凹底为例，直接推出工匠设计意识成熟的判断。

source_span.section: 2. 原始陶瓷器的形成与实用设计 / 1）陶器

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that the Xia-period pottery urn's change from a flat to a concave base helped raise the heat when food or water was warmed, showing that craftsmen's design awareness was gradually maturing.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，夏代陶瓮的底由平底改为凹形，有助于陶瓮中的食物或水在加温时提高热力，说明当时工匠的设计意识已经逐步成熟。

discussion_notes: 原文在列举东下冯原始青瓷残片后，以商周青釉瓷的普遍发现作出该年代判断。

source_span.section: 2. 原始陶瓷器的形成与实用设计 / 2）瓷器

statement_en: On the evidence of the many glazed stoneware finds of Shang and Zhou date from sites across China, Xia Yanjing concludes that porcelain was invented in China no later than the mid-Shang.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖据各地出土的商周时期大量青釉瓷断定，我国至迟在商代中期已经发明了瓷器。

discussion_notes: 原文引《尚书·甘誓》与《吕氏春秋·简读》，并直接给出“最早车战”“提早300年”的比较判断。

source_span.section: 3. 交通运输工具的设计规范 / 1）车

statement_en: Citing the oath in the Shangshu “Ganshi” sworn by Xia Qi before battle with the Youhu at Ganze, Xia Yanjing states that the Battle of Ganze was the earliest chariot battle in history, three hundred years before the Hyksos used chariots; he also quotes the Lüshi Chunqiu to the effect that Tang's army in the conquest of Xia was led by “seventy fine chariots.”
statement_zh: 夏燕靖据《尚书·甘誓》所载夏启与有扈氏战于甘泽的誓师词指出，甘泽之战是历史上最早的车战，比喜克索斯人使用战车提早了300年；又引《吕氏春秋·简读》称商汤灭夏时其军中主力便是“良车七十乘”。

discussion_notes: 原文在商代车结构叙述后，对中西系驾法作出比较判断。

source_span.section: 3. 交通运输工具的设计规范 / 1）车

statement_en: Xia Yanjing notes that Chinese horse-drawn chariots before the Spring and Autumn period all had a single shaft that rose at the front and carried a yoke for the horses, and that this yoke-and-harness method was considerably more advanced than the neck-harness method then used in the West.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖指出，我国春秋以前的马车都是独辕，车辕前部向上昂起，前端设衡轭以驭马；这种轭鞞式系驾法较当时西方的颈式系驾法先进得多。

discussion_notes: 原文在“建筑设计与城建布局”节总述夯土与木构架的发展脉络。

source_span.section: 4. 建筑设计与城建布局 / 1）建筑设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that buildings with rammed-earth walls and timber frames first appeared in the Xia-Shang-Zhou era: rammed-earth technique emerged in the Neolithic and matured by the Shang, while timber framing was progressively improved through Shang and Zhou until it became the principal structural form of Chinese architecture, with unprecedented courtyard complexes.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，夏商周时代以夯土墙和木构架为主体的建筑开始出现；夯土技术萌芽于新石器时代、至商代趋于成熟，木构架经商周不断改进，逐步发展成为我国古代建筑的主要结构形式，并出现前所未有的院落群组合。

discussion_notes: 原文在“城建布局”节引“周之所封四百余，服国八百余”及城制等级，并作出“立国之本”的判断。

source_span.section: 4. 建筑设计与城建布局 / 2）城建布局

statement_en: Xia Yanjing shows that Zhou rulers regarded founding capitals—city building—as the basis of the state, each capital being constituted first of all by walls and moats; cities were built according to noble rank, with the royal city nine li square, ducal cities seven, marquis and earl cities five, and viscount and baron cities three.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖指出，周代统治者把营建都邑即筑城看作立国之本，每个都邑都以城郭沟池为最基本的构筑；各都邑按封爵大小而建，王城方九里、公城方七里、侯伯城方五里、子男城方三里。

discussion_notes: 原文在说明深衣形制后，直接列举长衫、旗袍、连衣裙作为其延续。

source_span.chapter: 夏商周时期的艺术设计
source_span.section: 5. 丝纺织物与服饰艺术设计 / 2）服饰的制式与设计

statement_en: On the evidence of pre-Qin dress materials, Xia Yanjing states that the Zhou had adopted the shenyi system, joining the upper garment to the skirt; this form became a basic feature of Chinese dress through the dynasties, and the modern men's long gown, women's qipao and one-piece dress all continue the shenyi system.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖据先秦服饰资料指出，周代已采用深衣制，即在上衣下裳的基础上将上衣与围裙连接起来；这种形式成为我国历代服装的基本特征，近代男子的长衫、女子的旗袍、连衣裙都是深衣制的延续。
